title: Fairness in Dysarthric Speech Synthesis: Understanding Intrinsic Bias in Dysarthric Speech Cloning using F5-TTS
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical fairness metrics (Parity Difference and Disparate Impact) and performance disparities across speech severity levels and gender in speech synthesis for individuals with dysarthria. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or theological/ethical systems.
